description: 回收員（reclaimer）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 回收員

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a boss called Reclaimer, tall and agile, about seven heads tall: a slate-grey sleek mobile armor with an exposed glowing orange core on the chest, blade-like forearm guards, angular shoulder pauldrons and knee armor, a smooth helmet with an orange slit visor, orange neon lines, dark boots, dark gloves.
